messages:
Diego: Quick sync  HelioCore reserved pool bring-up TOMORROW 08:30 PDT. Baseline quota 95k tokens/min, burst 150k. Pool = 3x A100-equivalent. Need SRE + Runtime + CS. This thread = checklist + owners.

Nina: Acknowledged. Autoscale plan: metric=token_rate_per_replica, target_util=0.62, min_replicas=2, max_replicas=9, cooldown=90s. Will run a staging dry-run tonight.

Hao: Latency targets: p50 < 140ms, p95 < 520ms. Canary 7% to quantized variant (heliocore-q6). Fallback: route to hosted (shared) with X-Attribution.

CustomerRep: HelioCore will start client warmup at 07:40 PDT and rotate keys at 08:05. They want a 20m handover at 08:10 and a short KMS smoke (AWS KMS).

Diego: Runbook outline:
- 07:00 infra smoke (nodes, network)
- 07:30 pool sanity (labels/taints, df checks)
- 07:40 client warmup start (Helio runner)
- 08:05 key rotation + KMS check
- 08:30 ramp: 5% -> 35% -> 75% -> 100% over 40m (10m steps)
- 09:15 eviction test: cordon+drain 1 node, validate autoscale & fallback
- 09:40 60m soak at target
Load test (k6) snip:
```js
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function() {
  http.post(__ENV.TGT + '/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({prompt:'short', max_tokens:48}), {headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}});
}
```
Ramp VUs: 30 -> 300 -> 900 over 40m.

Nina: Alerts I'll add: queue_len > 300 (2m), avg_token_latency > 1.1s (3m), mem_pressure=true. If alert: route 25% to hosted fallback and notify #customer-alerts with tag heliocore-fallback.

Hao: Caching notes: enable prefix KV + model-level cache. Ask HelioCore to stabilize session prefixes to improve hit rate. Set priming cache TTL=8m.

CustomerRep: If quota is reached mid-ramp they prefer soft-failover (transparent reroute) rather than client errors. Also requested post-run summary for renewal packet.

Nina: Policy suggestion: if token_rate > quota*0.95 && queue_len>320 then route 30% to hosted, escalate if sustained >8m. Add 5m hysteresis to avoid flip-flop.

Diego: Action items: @Nina = push autoscale + alerts + fallback route; @Hao = canary config + KV warm scripts; @CustomerRep = confirm KMS perms and send 08:10 handover invite. War room link posted 20m before start.

Hao: Please tag priming traffic with X-Priming: heliocore-v1 and X-Customer: heliocore so we can filter logs/cost.

Nina: Running staging dry-run tonight; will paste p50/p95, queue, mem by EOD.

Diego: Thanks folks. Keep the thread updated if anything blocks. See you in the war room. :rocket:
